app.title: Context Loom · Less noise. Clearer context.
language.help: Independent of the interface language. Included in the project’s compiled instructions.
language.failure: The selected language could not be loaded. The current interface language has been kept.
nav.label: Workspace
sidebar.memories: Keep reusable decisions, not an entire chat history. Only this project’s selected memories enter its prompt.
sidebar.tokens: Shorter context can reduce input tokens. It does not guarantee less internal reasoning.
backup.help: Backups include private memories, never API keys. Imports add separate projects.
compose.title: Give your next task the right context.
compose.lead: A focused brief, the memories that matter, and an explicit choice about what happens next.
compose.task: What would you like to work on?
compose.placeholder: Describe the task, desired result, and anything specific to this request.
compile.local: Runs locally. No model call. No charge.
compile.changed: Context changed. Compile again before exporting or approving a request.
compile.profileDraft: Profile draft changed. Save the profile, then compile again.
compile.memoryDraft: Memory draft changed. Save it to include it in a new compilation.
compile.responseDraft: Review the response draft and save only the useful decision or fact, then compile again.
compile.failed: No fresh preview. Nothing was sent to a model.
compile.fresh: Fresh local preview. Export for USD 0, or separately approve a paid API request.
preview.title: Your portable prompt
preview.help: Token counts are approximate. Savings can be negative when the compiled brief adds more structure than it removes. Your destination chat’s own limits and pricing still apply.
api.title: Run directly with OpenAI
api.warning: Additional API charge versus USD 0 local export.
api.warningBody: Your existing chat subscription does not include API usage. This sends the compiled project context, selected memories, and task to OpenAI. No external tools are enabled; the request uses store: false.
api.pricingEmpty: Compile a prompt to see the model’s published rates, source, and checked date.
api.estimateHelp: The output estimate assumes the entire generation allowance is used, including reasoning tokens where applicable. These estimates are not hard financial caps or invoice guarantees; actual provider usage can differ.
api.keyNote: Only in this tab’s memory · never saved or included in backups
api.consentEmpty: Compile a fresh preview before approving a paid request.
api.consent: I approve one {model} API request with an estimated additional charge of {cost}. I understand this is not a hard spending cap and my chat subscription does not cover it.
api.noRetries: No automatic retries. Every request requires new approval.
api.sending: Sending one request. Do not close this tab; no automatic retries will occur.
api.finished: Request finished: {status}. Another request needs new explicit approval.
api.failed: Request failed or its result is unknown. No retry was made. Check usage before deciding whether to send again; a charge may have occurred.
api.notSent: Nothing was sent. Compile and approve again.
api.rates: {model} · USD per {million} tokens: input {input}, cached input {cached}, output {output}. Checked {date}.
answer.title: Model response
answer.save: Turn useful text into a memory…
answer.help: Review and edit before saving. The conversation is never automatically added to memory.
answer.empty: (No text returned. The request may be incomplete or refused; review its status and usage.)
answer.usageRecorded: {input} input ({cached} cached) · {output} output ({reasoning} reasoning) · actual usage-based cost {cost}. Recorded locally. Not an invoice guarantee.
answer.usageUnrecorded: {input} input ({cached} cached) · {output} output ({reasoning} reasoning) · actual usage-based cost {cost}. Warning: not recorded locally; retain this cost yourself. Not an invoice guarantee.
memory.title: Keep what is worth carrying forward.
memory.help: Use a short reusable fact or decision. Pinned memories get priority within the budget; disabled memories stay out.
memory.tagsNote: Comma-separated words that help match tasks
memory.empty: No memories yet. Add a reusable fact or decision above; only you choose what is saved.
memory.deleteConfirm: Delete this memory? This cannot be undone unless you have a backup.
profile.title: Project profile
clarification.blocking: Ask only if blocked; otherwise state assumptions
usage.title: Direct API usage
usage.help: All projects. Actual token usage reported by the provider; costs calculated by the server at the recorded rates. This is not an invoice or a spending limit.
usage.empty: No direct API requests recorded. Local compilations and exports are free and do not appear here.
usage.caption: Recorded direct API requests
welcome.title: Start with a project, not a wall of context.
welcome.help: Answer a few questions once. Keep relevant memories separate from other work, then compile a clear brief whenever you need it.
dialog.help: These answers become the project’s reusable instructions. You can change them at any time.
dialog.name: What is this project called?
dialog.goal: What should the model help you achieve?
dialog.goalPlaceholder: Describe the outcome, audience, and what success looks like.
dialog.inPlaceholder: Topics, files, or responsibilities to focus on.
dialog.outPlaceholder: What should not be changed, assumed, or explored?
dialog.constraintsPlaceholder: Requirements, conventions, tools, privacy, or hard limits.
dialog.detail: How much detail should answers use?
error.generic: The operation could not be completed. Review the technical details below.
error.unreadable: The local server returned an unreadable response ({status}). No state was replaced.
error.save: Local save failed. Your edits remain in this tab. Export a backup before closing, or make another edit to retry saving.
error.unsaved: Cannot continue until local state is saved.
error.taskLong: The task must be at most {limit} characters.
error.memoryBudget: Memory budget must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
error.outputCap: Output allowance must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
error.changedSaving: Context changed while saving. Compile again to include the latest edits.
error.changedCompile: Context changed during compilation. Compile again for a fresh preview.
error.approval: Compile a fresh preview and explicitly approve its estimated charge first.
error.key: Enter an API key to make a paid request.
error.changedSending: Context changed before sending. Compile and approve again.
error.usageRefresh: The response is shown, but usage history could not refresh.
error.backupObject: Backup must be a JSON object.
error.backupProjects: Backup must contain between 1 and {limit} projects.
error.backupStringRequired: {label} must be a non-empty string of at most {limit} characters.
error.backupString: {label} must be a string of at most {limit} characters.
error.backupId: {label} has an invalid or duplicate ID.
error.backupPreferences: {label} has invalid answer, language, or ambiguity preferences.
error.backupBoolean: {label} needs boolean pinned and enabled settings.
error.backupSize: Backup exceeds the 32 MiB file limit.
error.backupJson: That file is not valid JSON. No projects were imported.
error.importLimit: Import would exceed the {limit}-project limit. No projects were imported.
error.stateSize: Combined projects exceed the 24 MiB local-state limit. No projects were imported.
backup.importConfirm: Import {count} project(s)? These files may contain private memories. They will be added with new IDs; existing projects will not be replaced.
backup.exportConfirm: This backup includes all project profiles and private memories. Keep it secure. It contains no API keys or usage history. Continue?
error.stateFormat: Local state has an unexpected format.
error.activeProject: The saved active project is missing. State was not modified.
error.load: Could not load local state. Editing is disabled to avoid overwriting saved projects.
error.profileBlank: Project name and goal cannot be blank.
error.scopeLong: Combined in-scope and out-of-scope text must fit within {limit} characters.
error.projectLimit: You can have at most {limit} projects.
error.memoryLimit: A project can contain at most {limit} memories.
error.copyFresh: Compile a fresh preview before copying.
error.clipboard: Clipboard access was blocked. The prompt is selected; use your keyboard’s copy command.
error.downloadFresh: Compile a fresh preview before downloading.
error.answerProject: Switch back to the project that generated this response before saving it as a memory.
validation.number: Enter a valid number within the displayed limits.
launcher.keepOpen: Keep this window open while using Context Loom. Close it or press Ctrl+C to quit.
launcher.browserClosed: Closing the browser tab alone does not stop the app. Double-click the exe again to reopen it.
launcher.costWarning: Local compilation is free. API requests require separate approval and may incur charges.
launcher.browserFailed: The browser could not open automatically. Open {url} manually.
launcher.alreadyRunning: Context Loom is already running at {url}
launcher.dataSafe: Existing private data has not been reset. Check {path} and restart.
